name: GET_rest_timemanagement_absence_v1_availableTimeTypes
title: GET_rest_timemanagement_absence_v1_availableTimeTypes
description: Gets the available time types for the login user. The list is based on the Time Profile assigned to the user in Job Information.

parameters.name: $at
parameters.description: The date for which the available time types are requested. The date must be in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: absenceRequestCode
parameters.description: The external code of an existing absence which is used to filter the list of available time type.
